meta.title: Reparto / Reparto Pop — DJ Set Prep
source: YouTube screenshots provided by the PO, 2026-09-23, for an event starting 2026-09-24
meta.notes: Real tracklist curated from the PO's own YouTube screenshots — NOT a formal production dossier like the One Hit Wonder case study. genre is only set to 'reparto' when the source video itself carried a clear '#Reparto' hashtag or named the genre in its own title — everything else, including videos tagged '#Repaton' (an ambiguous variant the PO did not confirm means 'Reparto Pop'), is left genre:null for the DJ to classify rather than guessed. No duplicates: tracks re-sent across screenshot batches were collapsed to one entry. BPM UPDATE 2026-09-24: the PO asked to look for real BPM instead of leaving everything blank. Filled for 14/29 tracks from public sources (Tunebat, Mixgraph, Shazam, Apple Music, SongBPM — real published tempos, never estimated); each filled track has bpmSource citing where it came from. The remaining 15 are underground/very recent Cuban reparto releases with no BPM published anywhere findable — left null on purpose rather than guessed, still fillable live by the DJ as originally designed. energyEstimate stays null for all — no public source publishes energy ratings for this catalog.
